body: Admitted C1 with 5/5 pins verified: eight cells reproduced, no demonstrated mismatch, no fix. Its REVIEW and NFIC-SAME-MODEL explicitly say it reran the identical model63.py and did not rebuild the mass account. This is shared-model reproduction; the brief's independent-derivation requirement remains unmet. It does not independently clear shared assumptions, including NFI065-BETA-SCALE. Also, 2014-T6/glass-fabric describes the flight bulkhead; SDL 468's plotted specimen materials remain unverified. These qualifications accompany Sciences' admission for the Piece C record. This is no request for another round; the one-round result stands with its limits. C2 and the record delta remain pending.
